name: RER B
about: The RER B line (Ligne de Sceaux) across the map: its formation, tracks, catenary, platforms and stations (Lozère, Le Guichet, Orsay-Ville...), bridges, underpasses, fences, the yard's tracks; designed by tools/rail/build_rail.py (OSM, LiDAR) into its plan data/rerB/plan.json, its own ground (data/rerB/ground.*, builder/lot_ground.gd) and its changes to the map's world (data/rerB/drop.json: the trees and props in its way, its fences, Lozère's station building, the buildings over its tracks), built by builder/rail_builder.gd.
